messages:
sara_pm: quick PM follow-up from the fallback-loop postmortem. consolidated remediation items below. please claim with: owner / JIRA / RACI (R/A/C/I) / due (YYYY-MM-DD).

sara_pm: items: 1) resolve selector race (root: concurrent selector + cold-kv); 2) canary that warms KV and measures miss-rate; 3) incident playbook + mitigation checklist; 4) fallback cost detect + temporary throttle; 5) post-deploy perf smoke in CI; 6) meta-investigation: how often are rollouts coinciding with cold-starts?

jordan_eng: i'll take 1. owner: jordan_eng / JIRA: RI-3101 / RACI: R=jordan_eng A=sara_pm C=ara_runtime I=eng-all / due: 2026-08-04

molly_ops: i'll own 2 and coordinate cost with finance. owner: molly_ops / JIRA: RI-3102 / RACI: R=molly_ops A=platform-lead C=ara_runtime I=ops-team / due: 2026-08-12

diego_sre: i'll do 3 and 6. owner: diego_sre / JIRA: RI-3103 (playbook) RI-3106 (investigation) / RACI: R=diego_sre A=eng-sre C=oncall I=product / due: 2026-07-28 (3) and 2026-08-10 (6)

ara_runtime: i'll pick up 4 and 5. owner: ara_runtime / JIRA: RI-3104 (billing) RI-3105 (CI smoke) / RACI: R=ara_runtime A=finance,ci-team C=molly_ops I=eng-oncall / due: 2026-08-08 (4) 2026-07-30 (5)

molly_ops: note on 2: plan is a lightweight canary replaying a 3-minute traffic sample to warm KV and verify latency + miss-rate. est ~2 GPU-hours per run. will add checklist in RI-3102 and propose biweekly cadence.

diego_sre: for 3 i'll draft concrete mitigation steps: pin variant, scale pool, toggle rollouts, and a comms template for oncall. linking draft to RI-3103 today.

jordan_eng: for 1 i'll add a small harness and regression test in selector CI and propose a gating rule for rollout concurrency.

ara_runtime: for 4 i'll wire a billing anomaly metric and a short-lived throttle flag for runaway fallback loops; will coordinate staging test with molly.

ops-bot: Reminder created: "Remediation owners weekly check" starting 2026-07-15 14:00 UTC. Notified: jordan_eng, molly_ops, diego_sre, ara_runtime.

sara_pm: recap: RI-3101=jordan_eng, RI-3102=molly_ops, RI-3103=diego_sre, RI-3104=ara_runtime, RI-3105=ara_runtime, RI-3106=diego_sre. everyone add acceptance criteria and test plan in the JIRA. ops-bot will ping 48h before due dates. post here to hand off. thanks!
